title: Comfort & Soul
summary: Low and slow, well-seasoned layers — soul food depth comes from time, fond, and spice blend.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — comfort & soul is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: fat, salt, slow_cook, spice. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Finish with hot sauce or vinegar table-side
Pickled or fresh sides cut richness; acid at the table lets diners adjust.
